# Safe Remote Collaboration

## Start From Known Remote State

Fetch and inspect before starting shared work.

## Fetch Regularly

Regular fetches help you see what changed remotely.

## Focused Branches

Keep each branch about one purpose.

## Logical Commits

Commits should explain meaningful steps.

## Validate Before Push

Run safe checks before publishing commits.

## Review Status and Log

Use status and history to understand what will be shared.

## No Secrets

Never push passwords, tokens, credentials, private configuration, or confidential datasets.

## No Large Generated Files

Avoid pushing generated logs, caches, and large raw data by default.

## Communicate Overlapping Changes

Tell collaborators when editing the same SQL, script, config, or documentation.

## Do Not Bypass Conflicts

Conflicts require human decisions.

## Follow Team Policy

Teams may have specific review and merge rules.

## Avoid Force Push

Day 049 avoids force push and history rewriting.

## Small Pull Requests

Small reviews are easier to understand.

## Update Docs With Logic Changes

Documentation should stay aligned with SQL, scripts, and rules.

## Protected Main Conceptually

Some teams protect the default branch so changes must be reviewed before merge. Configuration details are outside Day 049.
